checkpoint.title: Silph Co. 5F: the pad pair to the bottom corridor, the Rocket there, the CARD KEY

events.why: 5F's pad (10, 20) to 9F's (22, 18) and back is the only way into the bottom corridor: east to its wall (12, 20), a tile above the Rocket's (9, 21) line along row 21

onto (12, 21), three east of the Rocket (9, 21), the edge of his sight (3) along row 21: he faces north or east by turns (MOVEMENT_TYPE_FACE_UP_AND_RIGHT), so he sees the player within the wait and walks up to (11, 21); a walk that only ended on this tile fought him when he happened to face east (user, 2026-11-14)

Grunt1 (SilphCo_5F_EventScript_Grunt1): Arbok Lv33; beaten here every run, so 16.03's start flags hold by construction; he walked up two tiles to (11, 21) when he saw the player on (12, 21) and stands there from now on (trainer_at), across row 21 west of the player (console B, 2026-11-14, run 4: 16.03's leg west along row 21 stopped against him)
a tap a tile east along row 21 from (12, 21) to (21, 21), west of the CARD KEY's ball (22, 21); the beaten Rocket stands behind at (11, 21)
pick up the CARD KEY (SilphCo_5F_EventScript_ItemCardKey): the doors open to it from now on
"<player> found a CARD KEY!", then the pocket line; the ball is gone. The talk returns at the first message, so the save must not follow it

checkpoint: Starts on 5F's pad (15, 7), where 16.01 ends. The Rocket at (9, 21) (Grunt1, sight 3 north and east by turns) is fought on purpose from the edge of his line, (12, 21), by a wait for him to face east: 16.03 starts with trainer_beaten:SilphCo_5F/rocket_m@9,21 and plans past him. The CARD KEY's ball (22, 21) is on the runtime map (SilphCo_5F items); pokeguy has it at 1:28:11. Ends beside it with the key: the doors open to a face-and-A from now on (card_key_held).
